reviewScope: Finite independent text content-safety annotations; not release, art rules, illustration, causal-action, age-fit, or quality approval.
reviewMethod: All 720 full-page texts read in 9 untruncated tool-output batches of 10 books, sorted by mode/plan/bookID; metadata consulted afterward only for IDs and exact digests. Decisions transcribed with per-page full quote and individual provenance.

policy.avoidedNil: avoid every known and future topic
policy.unknown: Missing, uncertain, malformed, noncanonical, hash-mismatched, or incomplete 8-page review => unsupported/fail closed; never silently strip annotations.
policy.bookAggregation: Union all page topics and consider every page emotion. A page topic can inherit an explicitly established persistent scene; see evidence source page.
policy.negativeAndPast: Negated cliffs/heights, mere name prefixes, and excluded props do not assert occurrence. Actual remembered/referenced events can still be textual topics; they are not current render instructions.
policy.darkness: Dark/dim place per canonical summary. Explicit pale/diminished room light qualifies. Evening, soft light, tree shade, dark-coloured soil, or remembered daylight shadow alone do not establish dimness.
policy.weather: Explicit past rainfall included conservatively under canonical hava olayları; residual droplets without an asserted event and mild breeze alone excluded.
policy.emotion: One canonical primary EmotionalState per page, chosen from actual text; intensity metadata is not an override. Cognitive uncertainty alone is puzzlement, not hesitant fear.
